description: This file implements a SQL processing utility for pandas-on-Spark DataFrames, including functions for executing SQL queries with embedded Python variables, handling DataFrame conversions, and managing Spark SQL sessions.

classes.name: SQLProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes SQL statements with embedded variables, manages temporary views, and executes queries on Spark.

methods.name: sql
methods.description: Main function to execute a SQL query with embedded Python variables, returning a pandas-on-Spark DataFrame.

methods.name: _get_local_scope
methods.description: Retrieves local variables from the call stack for variable substitution.

methods.name: _get_ipython_scope
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve variables from an IPython environment.

methods.name: escape_sql_string
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for safe inclusion in SQL queries.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the processed SQL statement and returns a pandas-on-Spark DataFrame.

methods.name: _convert
methods.description: Converts a variable key into its SQL string representation.

methods.name: _convert_var
methods.description: Converts a Python object into a SQL-compatible string.
